newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA- T-BILL YIELDS ON 182-DAY EDGE UP AT AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA- T-BILL YIELDS ON 182-DAY EDGE UP AT AUCTION.

text.p: Yields on Lithuanian 182-day Treasury bills edged up at Tuesday's auction, the country's central bank said.
The bank said that the average yield rose to 11.96 percent versus the 10.93 percent offered to dealers at the last auction for 182-day paper held on March 4.
The lowest yield was 11.40 percent and the highest accepted rate was 11.98 percent.
All of the 50 million litas issue was sold as 83.678 million litas worth of bids were placed.
